sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
sourceChecks.previousContext: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
sourceChecks.nextContext: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
